lint.why: No VM tests. Evaluates the whole flake, checks every flake check is in exactly one shard, builds the host's closure and the quick checks, then formats and lints. Its cache holds the host's closure, about 2 GB.

alerting.why: alerting-a, the first half of the alerting test (#182), waits out alert durations and is expected to take about 16 minutes. Only short VM tests share its second build slot; the other half, alerting-b, is in system, so the two run side by side.

services.why: The services the host runs: observability (about 12 minutes), Docker and the Compose stacks (the two largest VMs, 4 GB and 3 GB) and the announcements to players.

system.why: How the host is reached, deployed and booted: tailscale, comin, notify and disk-tpm, about 15 minutes one after another, in one build slot while alerting-b, the second half of the alerting test (#182, expected about 16 minutes), holds the other.
